request: Using hard–soft acid–base reasoning, hypothesise whether the soft acid Cd(II) is held more strongly by the soft base chloride or the borderline base ammonia near neutral pH. Then test it: compute Cd(II) speciation at 1 mM Cd with 0.1 M chloride and, separately, with 0.1 M ammonia, at pH 7, 25 C, I=0.1 m, and compare the free [Cd2+]. State whether the computation confirms or contradicts your HSAB prediction.
